services.name: Urban Sketching Course
services.desc: Ariel’s Urban Sketching: Explore, Observe, SketchJoin us for a 4-week immersive urban sketching class held on consecutive Saturdays. Each session includes a focused lesson, live demo, and a guided sketching walk to a nearby location. Weekly topics include: This hands-on course encourages creative observation and expression in urban spaces. Bring your sketchbook and sense of adventure! ages 16+ Saturdays: September 19th, & Oct 3rd, 17th 31st. 10 am - 12pm 🎟️ Cost: $70 for the whole course. ( you can choose to pay a drop in rate of $25 per class) Spots may be limited, so grab yours while you can!Please Bring the following supplies: Pencil (Mechanical or regular w/sharpener)Waterproof Ink Pen
